lines: Shuka-senpai, Hebiko and Shikanosuke. No matter how many mirrors the three of them attacked, they would disappear into mist, and appear again in another place.
The shadows of the student Taimanin were also repeatedly appearing and disappearing, and attacking us.
「Hebiko may be getting a little tired.」
I could see looks of fatigue on Hebiko and Shikanosuke.
Shuka-senpai still seemed to be all right, as I'd expect, but frustration was showing through in her eyes.
（All we have to do is destroy the real one. Anyway, an attack. But what, but what?――）
「Fuuma! You use your ability to fight too!」
I was desperately thinking of a plan, but, perhaps because it looked like I was spacing out, Shuka-senpai let off a rebuke.
「No, Senpai, Fuuma-chan is fine like that!」
「Yeah, yeah! It may look like he's zoned out, but he's trying as hard as he can to think of something, right?」
Hebiko and Shikanosuke stuck up for me.
If I had any means to fight, I'd like to help out too, but unfortunately I didn't have anything.
Well, technically I had the line powder I had been holding when I was sucked in.
（......Powder used for drawing white lines, huh......? Mmm?）
Hebiko made her eyes light up.
I gathered the three of them for a moment, and gave each of them simple instructions.
「I-I can only fire this one shot!!!」
Shikanosuke switched on the power to the battery that he carried around at all times these days, whereupon――
He fired a powerful shot of static electricity at the mirrors, Yukikaze and the others.
However, the group of mirrors and the shadow Taimanin were unfazed, even by that high-voltage attack. That was natural, since they were illusions.
Without a moment's delay, I tore open the bag of line powder, and threw it with all my might.
A cloud of white powder spread out, and our view immediately grew hazy.
「Gohogohoh?! Are you sure about this plan?!」
In a complete turnaround from the blackness, there was a whiteout, as if there had been a sudden blizzard, and within that space, I issued further instructions.
In this space, where visibility had become poor, Shikanosuke activated his radio wave sonar.
This was a means of making use of his weak electricity, which entailed seeking out objects in his surroundings by emitting radio waves and picking up their reflections.
「――There!!! I definitely sense one of them!」
「It's no use, Fuuma! It's moving at an unbelievable speed, and I can't fix it at a specific location!」
The real “Phantasmic Illusion Mirror” seemed to be creating illusions of itself in the mist to fool our eyes, while it itself was changing places constantly.
Shuka suddenly rushed out in front of me and deflected something with her swords.
「It looks like visibility doesn't matter to the shadows. These guys are attacking relentlessly!」
Shuka, who was experienced at actual combat, had sensed the signs of an attack, and protected me at the last moment.
「Shuka is fine! This is an emergency!」
「But now, instead, we're at a disadvantage, aren't we?! What the hell are you trying to do?」
Hebiko spat octopus ink towards the space where the white powder was swirling around.
The free-flowing octopus ink stuck to the line powder that fluttered through the air, and, having grown heavier, the powder fell to the ground, and our view instantly cleared up.
「Th-This is your plan? All you did was go to a lot of trouble to put things back the way they were!」
「This is what you were aiming for, right, Fuuma?!」
When Shuka turned around, the innumerable mirrors were still present there.
A white mirror, comically covered in line powder, was changing location constantly.
「You were aiming for this to happen because of Shikanosuke's static electricity, and the line powder you scattered after that?!」
Indeed. Only the real mirror, which had physical form, had been showered in Shikanosuke's static electricity and become electrically charged.
Then, due to that static electricity, the line powder had stuck to it, making only the real mirror stand out.
「Now you can do it, right?! Could you please, Shuka?!!!」
「You knew my Evil Eye ability, huh? Got it. Leave it to me!」
She took a step forward, and leapt towards the space where the true mirror, which continued changing places rapidly――
Shuka's Evil Eye was the ability to predict her opponent's movements.
Finishing off the mirror, which changed places incessantly, would be precisely her forte.
The pure-white mirror appeared in front of Shuka's eyes, and
「Looks like we were able to make it back, huh?」
Once Shuka destroyed the mirror, the scene around us reverted back to Gosha Academy. The whole spell had been broken.
At that point, making a heavy creak, the door to the storeroom opened.
「Ah, Tokiko! Man, we just had an awful time!」
For some reason, Tokiko was glaring straight at me, with a stern expression.
「Mmm? You are the real thing, right, Tokiko?」
「I decided I should come to check on you after my remedial class was over...... What on earth is the meaning of this?」
Being told that, I looked around.
The inside of the PE storeroom had turned bright white.
「I get it...... The line powder had real substance, so it got brought back just like it was, huh......?」
「What are you saying incomprehensible things for?」
I suddenly realized the situation due to Tokiko's menacing look.
That basically, to her eyes, we had been slacking off from cleaning, and playing around with the line powder......
「I'm going to ask you all. Who was it that scattered this line powder?」
Perhaps daunted by Tokiko's death stare, Hebiko, Shikanosuke and Shuka silently pointed my way.
......Well, come to think of it, it was true, but...
「Wh-Why you...?! Inviting that kind of misunderstanding... Is our bond no better than a bunch of animals'?!」
Bad. This was bad. To all appearances, the situation was me making excuses on my own.
「No ice cream for Lord-sama! And gaming is off limits for three days! Understood?」
「N-No way?! Sure, I may have scattered it, but... That's because the real mirror......!」
「Are you still trying to make some kind of excuse?」
Seeing the face Tokiko made when she was utterly furious, I gave up and fell silent, figuring that if I said anything more, it would only pour fuel on the fire.
Leaving me with, 「Kindly take responsibility and clean it up, will you?」 Tokiko shut the creaking door and left.
The traitors silently patted the back of me, their poor sacrifice.
A few days after that happened――
I was reading a book, alone, when Shuka called out to me.
「Would you like a yakisoba sandwich? I'll treat you.」
In Shuka's hand was one of the highly popular yakisoba sandwiches, which always sold out three minutes after lunch break began.
「After that happened, I heard from Hebiko. She said you haven't had an ability until recently, right?」
「And that even the ability you awoke to isn't very clear.」
「Yeah, that's true, actually. I'm in the middle of researching that matter right now.」
「I'm sorry for saying an insensitive thing like “Use your ability” back then. This is an apology for that.」
Shuka awkwardly averted her eyes, and quietly placed the yakisoba sandwich in front of me.
「It's fine. I don't mind that at all. But, uh, if you're treating me, I'll gratefully accept♪」
I took the sandwich, and promptly bit into it.
「I was impressed by your fighting. It was some superb teamwork.」
I gazed at Shuka's face as I hurriedly swallowed down the yakisoba sandwich.
「When we were surrounded by mirrors, if you were simply going to identify the real one, you could have just done it with Shikanosuke's radio wave sonar or something.」
「Ultimately, since the mirror was travelling at ultrahigh speed, that meant we couldn't defeat it with that alone.」
「Did you know that all along? And that's why you were trying to mark the real mirror with line power from the beginning?」
If the mirror hadn't been moving, we likely would have been able to defeat it as long as we had its position indicated with Shikanosuke's radio wave sonar.
But in the end, we couldn't defeat it with that alone, and would not have been able to catch the mirror had we not relied on Shuka's ability.
「It's simple. It was that cueball, Fürst.」
「The guy who was disguising himself as Muroi-sensei, you mean?」
「He was brimming with confidence that he could imprison us inside the mirror forever.」
「That guy's fought us before. On top of which, that confidence in himself――I was convinced he wasn't just an illusion.」
Shuka nodded with a serious face.
「I figured there was something to that, so I formulated about three hypotheses and plans, but that one was the biggest nuisance of all of them.」
「Even if we knew the position of the mirror, it was impossible to land a hit on it just by ourselves.」
It was because Fürst knew that that he had seemed so full of confidence.
His one and only miscalculation was that he never expected Shuka to be with us.
「Hmmm. So, you're saying it's thanks to me?」
「............Well then. I know! Come with Senpai for a moment.」
Shuka smiled impishly, and pulled on my arm to make me get up.
「Never wait to do a good deed, right?」
While being pulled along by Shuka-senpai, I checked the change in my pocket.
